component.name: Pocket XR PC Screens
component.summary: Use this computer's screens on your phone and glasses with Pocket XR

description.p: Sets this computer up for Pocket XR's PC screens: up to three screens, each its own virtual screen at the size of the phone's window (KDE Plasma on Wayland), streamed with Sunshine.
Includes Sunshine by LizardByte (GPL-3.0), with two small changes.
